newsitem.title: UK: Pharmacia, Gilead get Vistide clearance.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia, Gilead get Vistide clearance.

text.p: Pharmaceuticals group Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc and Gilead Sciences Inc said on Friday they received European clearance to market the Vistide treatment for cytomegalovirus retinitis in patients with AIDS.

In a joint statement, the companies said the Committee for Proprietary Medicinal Products (CPMP), the European regulatory body for the pharmaceutical industry, had cleared the intravenous treatment for marketing in Europe.
In August, Gilead licensed to Pharmacia & Upjohn the exclusive right to market Vistide in all countries outside the U.S., the companies said.
CMV retinitis is a viral infection of the retina that impairs vision and can lead to blindness. It affects between 15 and 40 percent of AIDS patients, the companies said.
